summary.result: It is found that permeability coefficient is proportional to fractal dimension and inversely proportional to percent of fines.
summary.background: Since particle size distribution curves are useful to estimate permeability of soil, many formulae for permeability coefficient (k) have been published using the parameter from the curves and factors, such as grain size, particle shape and void ratio of soils.
summary.method: An empirical formula of permeability coefficient has been developed with fractal dimension and percent of finer than 0.075 mm.
